sources.symbol: short getchoice(short number, short initems, short candead)

castleSourceObservation.getchoiceAbortResult: Clears every track entry to zero and returns through the abort label.
castleSourceObservation.orderAbortHandling: Ignores getchoice's result and indexes c[track[t] - 1] for every party member.

realmz2ChosenResult.cancelBehavior: Discard the presentation-owned draft without emitting an intent or mutating PartyState.
realmz2ChosenResult.applyPrecondition: The intent must contain every current stable character ID exactly once.
